questions.stem: In a potometer experiment, what does the movement of the air bubble indicate?

options.text: The rate of photosynthesis in the leaves
The rate at which carbon dioxide enters the leaf
The rate at which the plant is using up oxygen
The rate at which the shoot is taking up water

questions.explanation: As the shoot takes up water through transpiration, water moves along the capillary tube to replace it. The air bubble moves along the tube at the same rate as water uptake, allowing us to measure it.
